A fusion of Flyscissors and Demonshead using dedicated parts.
The protagonist once traveled as a mercenary Zoid pilot. The space−time fusion turned him into a Zoid Warrior. His bloodline hides a secret that even he does not know.
A young Zoid pilot whom the protagonist meets after the space−time fusion. She has no memory of her past, and the secret group Terra Geist is hunting her. She is a gifted Zoid pilot.
Zan serves in Blue Unicorn, a Republic unit that tests prototype Zoids. He is impulsive but often has sharp insights. His skill lets him sense a Zoid’s will.

A member of the Republic prototype test unit Blue Unicorn. She is Zan’s childhood friend and joined the army to follow him. She loves Zan but cannot tell him. She is a skilled shot but cannot take many hits.
The leader of the Republic prototype test unit Blue Unicorn. His wartime experience drove him to train new soldiers. He is capable in every field, but command and strategy are his strengths.
Reiner serves in Rottiger, the Imperial police unit that hunts Zenebas remnants. This wealthy, confident pilot has great potential. He and Zan share a fierce rivalry.

The leader of the Imperial special military police unit Rottiger. She comes from an elite military family and is very proud. Max was once her superior, but she was promoted first and placed in command of Rottiger.

A member of the Imperial special military police unit Rottiger. He is an excellent soldier, but his habit of saying too much hurt his career. Claudia, once his subordinate, asked him to join Rottiger.

Dr. T was testing a Zoid enhancement system in Arcadian ruins when the space−time fusion struck. After the protagonist rescued him, they set out to restore the world. Few things matter to him more than Zoids.
Athle is the prince of Arcadia. He defended the kingdom’s space−time transfer device from an Imperial invasion. After the fusion, he searched for Dr. T and a way home.
One of Arcadia’s Three Beasts. She tutors and guards Athle, who carries Ancient Zoidian blood. She is serious, responsible, and sometimes meddlesome. She knows ancient technology well.
One of Arcadia’s Three Beasts and a former Guylos Imperial officer. He supports Athle as part of the group. He is quiet but has a very sharp tongue. He excels in close combat.
One of Arcadia’s Three Beasts. This former Helic Republic officer leads Athle’s three guardians. He is the sensible member of the group.
Van is a boy from Wind Colony who loves Zoids. In ancient ruins, he met Fiona and the Organoid Zeke. They set out to uncover Fiona’s past. His partner is the Blade Liger.
Fiona awoke in ancient ruins with no memory of her past. She joined Van to discover her identity and learned that she descends from the Ancient Zoidians. She is kind but often lost in thought.
He first pursued Van’s Organoid, Zeke, but became Van’s friend during their travels. His partner Zoid is the Command Wolf. His eye patch is a camera that can record images.
Moonbay is a wasteland courier who joined Van’s journey by chance. She became a big sister to Van and Fiona, balancing firm advice with genuine care.
Herman is a Republic officer and the president’s son. He recognized Van’s talent at the Red River front. His stubborn courage and battlefield leadership earned his soldiers’ trust.
Ford is a Republic major and Colonel Krueger’s aide. He often commands in Krueger’s place. His steady tactics favor results over spectacle.
A Republic lieutenant and Herman’s aide. He serves on the front line beside Herman. Like his superior, he can be stubborn.

A Republic colonel. He was recalled from the reserves when the Guylos Empire invaded and took command of the Republic Army. His unusual tactics made him a magician of the battlefield. He served alongside Van’s father.
Two years after the battle with Death Saurer, Van has become a highly skilled pilot under Colonel Krueger. He serves in the Guardian Force, which keeps peace between the Republic and Empire.
Fiona’s true name is Elisi Linette. After recovering her Ancient Zoidian memories, she worked as Dr. D’s assistant. She later rejoined Van and remains warmhearted and absentminded.
Irvine continued working as a bounty hunter after the battle with Death Saurer. He eventually joined Van, Thomas, and the other members of the Guardian Force.
Moonbay stayed with Van after the battle with Death Saurer and joined the Guardian Force. Herman later chose her to pilot the Ultrasaurus, which she quickly treated as her own.
Karl Schubaltz is an Imperial colonel who commands the First Armored Division. The experienced officer comes from a respected military family. Difficult assignments always seem to find him.
Thomas Schubaltz is an Imperial lieutenant in the Guardian Force and Karl’s younger brother. He built the AI Beak, which he claims is better than an Organoid. He falls for Fiona as soon as they meet.
After losing to Van, Raven wandered without his memories. Once they returned, Hiltz invited him to fight again.
An Ancient Zoidian who travels with the blue Organoid Specular. She specializes in psychic attacks and often works alone. After Hiltz betrays her, she joins Raven, who saved her life.
Bit was a traveling scrap dealer before he met Liger Zero. Their bond brought him into the Blitz Team and the world of competitive Zoid battles.

Leena is Dr. Toros’s daughter and a Blitz Team pilot. She looks sweet but fights with wild, headlong aggression. Her selfish streak causes trouble for the entire team. She has more in common with her father than either admits.
Brad is a freelance Zoid Warrior hired by the Blitz Team. He acts as if money is his only concern, but he is loyal and kind beneath the act.
Dr. Toros’s dependable assistant. He manages the Blitz Team’s tactics and mechanical work. He is usually gentle, but exceeding the speed of sound in an aerial Zoid turns him into the Wild Eagle.
A former Blitz Team Zoid Warrior. He left to train and seek his ideal Zoid, then found a red Blade Liger. He later formed the Fluegel Team with Naomi. He is Dr. Toros’s son and Leena’s older brother.
Naomi is a master marksman known as the Red Comet. She built her reputation through solo victories. After Leon saved her, they formed the Fluegel Team.
Kirkland leads the Tigers Team, a trio of proud Zaber Fang pilots who love to talk big. Their first loss to the Blitz Team began a long losing streak.
Omari is one of the Tigers Team’s three Zaber Fang pilots. He is loud, proud, and quick to anger when anyone mocks the team.
Lineback is one of the Tigers Team’s three Zaber Fang pilots. Like his teammates, he boasts before each battle and takes every loss hard.
Harry calls himself a man destined to be king. His fortune supplies the Champ Team with the finest Zoids. He pines for Leena and treats Bit as his rival.
Mary is Harry’s older sister and a wealthy Zoid collector. She takes an instant liking to Bit’s Liger Zero and challenges it to a battle.
Jack Cisco is a bounty hunter and wandering gambler. He pilots the Lightning Saix and repeatedly faces the Blitz Team as a hired Zoid Warrior.
Alster was traveling to the underground world when the space−time fusion pulled him into another era. There he met the protagonist and joined the group.
Palty joined Alster when he left for another adventure. The space−time fusion carried them into the protagonist’s world.
Solid is an Imperial soldier and Alster’s rival. Circumstances forced him to travel with Alster’s group despite their rivalry.
Blue Gem is a Zoid engineer from the latest era joined by the fusion. His advanced knowledge makes him a valuable technical adviser to the group.
A mysterious Zoid pilot who flies a Storm Sworder and helps Van’s group. He resembles Rudolph, emperor of the Guylos Empire, but his true identity is unknown.
Benjamin is one of Harry Champ’s robots on the Champ Team. During one battle, he meets a Judge and falls hopelessly in love.
Sebastian is one of Harry Champ’s robots on the Champ Team. He is a rare voice of common sense within the team.
Dr. Toros manages the Blitz Team and maintains its Zoids. His strange behavior hides real engineering talent, though some call him an obsessed Zoid fan. He is Leon and Leena’s father.
A mysterious Zoid pilot who flies a Storm Sworder and helps Van’s group. He resembles Rosso, leader of the Desert Alcobaleno bandits, but his true identity is unknown.
A mysterious Zoid pilot who flies a Storm Sworder and helps Van’s group. She resembles Viola, the only woman in the Desert Alcobaleno bandits, but her true identity is unknown.
Gard is a Terra Geist officer who seeks to restore the Zenebas Empire. He vanished after fighting Zan’s unit. The space−time fusion brought him back as an ally of Backdraft.
Lezard was once honored as a Zenebas hero. A conspiracy drove him from the army and into Terra Geist. He later infiltrated the Republic and stole military secrets.

Gard raised Leviathe after finding her orphaned by war. His harsh training made her a skilled pilot, and she trusts him completely. After underestimating the protagonist, she becomes a recurring rival.
Stinger is a bounty hunter who pursues Van’s group. His polished appearance hides a cruel coward who favors poison gas and dirty tactics. At bars, he orders milk for his health and looks.
Altair is a Backdraft executive who uses the Commission’s collapse after the fusion to seek control. He allies with Terra Geist to acquire powerful Zoids and pilots.
Fuma leads Backdraft’s covert assassination unit. Altair sends her to attack the protagonist’s group.
A Backdraft Zoid Warrior. He had retired, but Altair’s orders and an encounter with Bit’s group brought him back to Zoid battles.
Pierce is a Backdraft pilot who specializes in aerial combat. Repeated battles with Bit and Jamie make them lasting rivals.
Vega pilots Berserk Fury, an Ultimate X revived by Backdraft. His exceptional instincts let him predict where an opponent will move next.
Polta is a Backdraft pilot sent by Altair to find Juno. He outwits Leviathe and captures Juno himself.
A Guylos Imperial marshal who later becomes regent. He plots to murder Rudolph and take the throne. At the same time, he schemes to revive Death Saurer and rule the world.
Dr. D was once a renowned Republic scientist. He returned from retirement as the war grew worse and now supports Van with supplies and advice. He drinks his coffee with salt.
Dr. Laon has competed with Dr. Toros since their student days. His repeated challenges against the Blitz Team end in defeat. Backdraft eventually recruits him.
Fran is one of the four Imperial generals who once fought Athle’s group. Earth, one of Arcadia’s Three Beasts, is her longtime rival.
Gale is one of the four Imperial generals who once fought Athle’s group. He is a former Republic soldier who once trained Jack.

Opis is one of the four Imperial generals who once fought Athle’s group. The Empire banished this former Zoid researcher for dangerous experiments. His methods earned him a reputation as a mad scientist.
Blood is one of the four Imperial generals who once fought Athle’s group. He vanished until the space−time fusion brought him back. He now works with Gard while pursuing a hidden goal.
Judge is an impartial referee dispatched by the Zoid Battle Commission. The fusion disabled the Judge system, allowing Backdraft to seize control in secret.
Dark Judge officiates Backdraft’s illegal battles. He enforces his decisions without regard for fairness and rejects every protest.
Van’s white Organoid partner. Zeke can strengthen Zoids. Like Fiona, he was awakened by Van in ancient ruins.
A black Organoid who travels with Raven. Hiltz destroys him once, but he later returns.

{01 02}Regina
{01 00}Don’t lie to me. You are Athle…

{01 02}Earth
{01 00}No Matrix Dragon formation, so I’m opening the camp menu!

{01 02}Jack
{01 00}Let’s split up and check out the town.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}No way. Forget it. Too much hassle…

{01 02}Jack
{01 00}The town has new rulers. They probably want everyone to know it.

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}I’d love to see a Zoid battle sometime. Is there one going on near here?

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}That must be the town they meant. There’s something I want to look into. Can we stop for supplies?

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}This is the test we were talking about.

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Looks like we’re in for something big…

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}All right, let’s go over the startup sequence.

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}I’ll take control of any Zoid set to automatic mode.

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}First, disengage the power safety locks. Follow the manual.

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}That’s normal. The fusion system sometimes shakes on startup.

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}Calm down! They haven’t attacked us yet!

{01 02}Mysterious Man
{01 00}Claudia! A Zoid dead ahead of you!

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}Hm! I’ve never seen a Zoid like that.

{01 02}Claudia
{01 00}I’ll hail them. This is the Imperial Army…

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}They mean it! Hesitate and you die!

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}Same as last time… Looks like we’ve been thrown into another world.

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}The shock forced our Zoids apart. We’ll need Deck Commands to combine again.

{01 02}Tita
{01 00}No sign of the Empire’s Rottiger, Captain!

{01 02}Zan
{01 00}Heh! Got scared and ran for it?

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}They’re probably as lost as we are…

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}That space−time distortion Dr. T mentioned has spread a long way.

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}There’s no predicting what the distortion will do. Anything could happen.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Okay. Let’s find out where we’ve ended up.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}I hope there’s a way back to our own world.

{01 02}Zan
{01 00}There’s more than one space−time distortion, right?

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Right. There may be other distortions somewhere.

{01 02}Zan
{01 00}So maybe one of them leads back to our own world?

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}Sorry. It’s just funny hearing you say that.

{01 02}Tita
{01 00}Since when do you think things through, Zan?

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Looks like there’s a town nearby. Let’s take a look.

{01 00}Mm, the details get complicated… Something like that…

{01 02}Herman

{01 02}Irvine
{01 00}Phew… I really thought we were done for this time…

{01 02}{03}

{01 00}Looks like the enemy is lying in wait.

replace_lines: {01 00}They must be pretty sure of themselves.

entries.text:
{01 02}Radio
{01 00}So it was you who beat Lezard…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}So you are {03}… And some faces I haven’t seen in a while.

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}So you were with the Backdraft after all!?

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Indeed. Dealing with them requires a certain status. I call myself Duke now.

{01 02}Claudia
{01 00}How convenient. We can finish our mission right here.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Don’t imagine you can beat this Bloody Demon!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}And ZOS has raised my power further!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}This is as far as you go. Be ready!

{01 02}Radio
{01 00}So a copy only gets this far…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}What! I am Duke Gard of Terra Geist…

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Is there anyone they won’t manipulate?! Damn it! Juno!

{01 02}Radio
{01 00}Well done… It seems I must bring you down myself…

{01 02}Radio
{01 00}But first, someone wants to meet you…

{01 02}Radio
{01 00}Go and play with her… I will be waiting in the cave by Lake Breton, north of here…

{01 02}Fran
{01 00}That’s right. We don’t need you. Just hand over what you carry.

{01 02}Blood
{01 00}Athle, we’ll settle this back in our own world!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Heh heh… So you’ve come this far.

{01 02}Claudia
{01 00}Gard! I should’ve known. So you’ve taken Viper’s place as leader of Terra Geist?

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Not so. Viper was only a piece on my board. As were Leviathe and Juno!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}In the end I will rule the world. That much does not change.

{01 02}Max
{01 00}Ruling the Empire was your ambition. Now it’s the whole world!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}The powerful take what they deserve. Nothing more.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}And the foundation of that power is Juno.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Let me tell you why Juno is here.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Juno is an artificial lifeform, made from the genes of the ancient Zoidians as the Zenebas Empire’s trump card before its fall.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}They added the Death Saurer’s genes to hers, giving her the power to control it.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}But the Zenebas Empire fell, and my family died, betrayed by the Guylos…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}I’ve waited all this time for a chance to avenge them.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Only a few people in the Empire knew Juno was still alive.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Then the space−time upheaval brought her straight to me. Everything I needed, delivered to my doorstep.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Juno is here to wake Death Meteor, the evolved form of the Death Saurer!

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Don’t tell me you don’t know what’s become of this world!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}You mean the upheaval in space and time?

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Rest easy. ZOS can break the wall of space−time.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Any world in my way I’ll wipe away!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}And with this Death Meteor I can rule any world at all.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Whatever world I’m in, my ambition will be fulfilled!

{01 02}Zan
{01 00}Scary guy. We can’t let him have this world.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}We’ll stop your ambition, whatever it takes!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Death Meteor will soon have you begging for mercy.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}And the source of that power is Juno.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}The hour has come. Return to your master’s embrace!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}For the rebirth of Zenebas, the hour of waking has come!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Ha ha ha! At last, my ambition is within reach!

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Argh! How on earth do we save Juno?!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Blast that Juno. Less use than I hoped!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Wait. If Death Meteor dies, Juno’s life ends with it…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Now feel the full power of ZOS!

{01 02}Altair
{01 00}You walked into the trap, Duke Gard!

{01 02}Altair
{01 00}You never suspected we’d altered Leviathe’s body itself.

{01 02}Altair
{01 00}Enjoy your trip to the far side of space and time!

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Where is this…? That blast must have thrown us clear.

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}We seem to be near Sandstorm Arena…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}But luck is still with me… It didn’t go as he hoped…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}My ambition will be fulfilled, whatever it takes!

{01 02}Juno
{01 00}I was so scared… I could feel Death Meteor inside my mind…

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Well done, {03}. The Whale King seems to have found us.

{01 02}Blood
{01 00}Well now, I got tired of waiting!

{01 02}Regina
{01 00}I was hoping we’d never see him again.

{01 02}Gale
{01 00}Come quietly and you’ll get home safe.

{01 02}Fran
{01 00}That’s right. Just hand over what you carry.

{01 02}Opis
{01 00}We have known for a while that you have the original.

{01 02}Blood
{01 00}You don’t plan on handing it over quietly, do you?

{01 02}Blood
{01 00}…Gard is at the ruins northeast of here, running the final stage of his plan…

{01 02}Blood
{01 00}I would have liked that one for myself…

{01 02}Blood
{01 00}Putting space and time back is up to you. Goodbye…

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Whatever he meant, we have one less enemy…

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}War with the Republic? That was long ago…

{01 02}Imperial Soldier
{01 00}Been to the Imperial institute yet? Zoid research is further along in the Empire.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}Prince Rudolph is so gallant. Those eyes of his!

{01 02}Zan
{01 00}This… looks like the Imperial town we visited before…

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}So that town has fused into this world!

{01 02}Zan
{01 00}That Rudo… I mean, uh, Royal Mask might know something!

{01 02}Albane
{01 00}True, but if he shows up it could complicate things…

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}My family has been poor for generations!

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}That chest has been here forever. Wonder what was in it.

{01 02}Old Man
{01 00}Nothing in the world makes sense to me lately.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}Nobody else notices, but… the Imperial Army is gone! I’m certain!

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}Vacation is the best! I don’t want to go home.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}I came here to train, but I got a little too comfortable.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}Before I knew it, I’d spent the whole trip having fun.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}Did my kid wander off in all the excitement?

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}I come to McCulley once a year.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}Lively, just like a tourist town should be.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}I’ve gotta buy souvenirs for the neighbors.

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}McCulley lives up to the hype! This is the best!

{01 02}Barkeep
{01 00}The customers here are a whole different class!

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Hey, there’s Bit… Is that a woman with him?

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}You’re Pierce, from the Backdraft! Mind explaining what you’re doing here?

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}Even Backdraft Warriors take a little time off for holidays, you know.

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}Zoid pilots who break all the rules have no right calling themselves Warriors.

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}We don’t break the rules to win. Merely to make the battle more exciting.

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}Battles bound by the Zoid Battle Commission’s rules are nothing but child’s play.

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}We prefer to spice things up with our own special kind of battles.

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}And what about how the Zoids feel?

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}Figures. I mean the Zoids who want to fight their battles fairly.

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}That’s the childish attitude I was talking about.

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}Grow up, Bit Cloud. You could really go places.

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}So what if we bend the rules a little? A Warrior should be able to face all sorts of dangers.

replace_lines: {01 00}A Warrior shouldn’t be bound by rules!

entries.text:
{01 02}Bit
{01 00}A real Warrior fights according to his own will.

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}The Backdraft pilots are forced to fight dirty!

{01 02}Pierce
{01 00}Chill out, Bit. You’ll find the battles much more amusing.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Cheer up, Bit. Let’s enjoy the vacation!

{01 02}Townsperson
{01 00}There’s a Zoids Institute in every town you visit.

{01 02}Dr. Toros
{01 00}We analyzed the data from the Judge system and got a predicted impact point.

{01 02}Dr. Toros
{01 00}Around the Kingdom of Arcadia, where that space−time wall stood!

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Arcadia holds a space−time transfer device!

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}We have to stop it, whatever it takes!

{01 02}Dr. Toros
{01 00}Unfortunately… I can’t decode the command that stops its fall…

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Death Meteor’s ZOS is distorting the space around us!

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}The space−time wall is collapsing! At this rate this world will vanish.

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}The Judge Satellite’s falling and now the space−time wall too!

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Doctor! Let’s trust the tablet’s prophecy! There’s nothing else!

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}If Pulse is tied to Arcadia’s space−time transfer device, then we have to go there.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Together, Blitz Tiger and Pulse can bring ZOS to full power.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}That should let us put space and time back the way they were.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}The Blitz Tiger was sent from the future for that!

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Maybe the tablet’s prophecy was advice from the future…

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Could it be you, in the future, who sent the Blitz Tiger…?

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}All right. I’m betting on you and Pulse!

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}…But we still have the Judge Satellite to deal with… or Bit’s world will…

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}That’s my job! Leave it to me!

{01 02}Dr. Toros
{01 00}Bit, my boy, moments like this call for one thing. It’s ready for you.

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}We’ll smash it with the Liger Panzer!

{01 02}Juno
{01 00}There’s no time. I can stop it. Let’s go!

{01 02}Juno
{01 00}I’ll ride in the Blitz Tiger with you!

{01 02}Judge
{01 00}Warning! Judge Satellite is going down! Impact any second!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}You thought me finished. A pity for you…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}I simply slipped deep underground in the confusion of the blast…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}I picked up another ZOS signal and followed it back to the surface. And here we are.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}My ambition is destined to be fulfilled!

{01 02}Claudia
{01 00}We’re not going to stand by and let him do this!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}One last desperate struggle? Very well. Indulge yourselves.

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Who wants to die? Come at me!

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Whatever it takes, I’m bringing you down!

{01 02}Juno
{01 00}You’re the one who can’t win, Gard!

{01 02}Juno
{01 00}{03}, Death Meteor saw into my mind. Now it knows…

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}What is it? Why don’t you attack!

{01 02}Gard
{01 00}Why… am I… not the heir of Zenebas…

{01 02}Leviathe
{01 00}Lord Gard! Not yet… I can still… fight.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Into the Arcadia ruins! The rest of you, fall back!

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}…If the space−time disorder is set right, everyone will return to their own world…

{01 02}Dr. T
{01 00}Then one place is as good as another… I’ll wait here.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Yes, I promise. Whatever world I’m in, I’ll find you.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}You’ve done so much for us, Pulse. Thank you.

{01 02}{03}
{01 00}Here we go, Pulse! ZOS power, full!

{01 02}Leena
{01 00}Hey! Bit! What are you spacing out for!

{01 02}Bit
{01 00}Sorry… I just had this feeling someone was missing from the team.

{01 02}Brad
{01 00}Here we go again. Bit’s off in his own little world.

{01 02}Leena
{01 00}Huh? What are you talking about! Snap out of it! The Backdraft just battle−jacked us!

{01 02}Altair
{01 00}Heh heh heh. This time I’ll outwit the Commission and conquer the world.

{01 02}Polta
{01 00}…Lord Altair… This time? But the plan just started…

{01 02}Dr. D
{01 00}Ho ho, all is right with the world… Now, some hot coffee.

{01 02}Fiona
{01 00}Yes, Doctor. With plenty of salt, right?

{01 02}Regina
{01 00}Is something wrong, Your Highness? We’re almost at the ruins Dr. T found.

{01 02}Message from Dr. T
{01 00}Prince Athle, I have bad news. The tablet we found says these artifacts form a Zoid enhancement system, but…

{01 02}Message from Dr. T
{01 00}It needs a special Organoid to work. Unfortunately, someone seems to have taken it already.

{01 02}Athle
{01 00}Well, they are ruins… these things happen. Keep the survey going.

{01 02}Lezard
{01 00}Let’s go, Leviathe… We will find Lord Gard, wherever he is…
